data_index_of:
pub fn data_index_of(bit: u32) -> (result: (usize, usize))
        ensures result.0 == bit as int / 64, result.1 == bit as int % 64,
get:
pub fn get(&self, bit: u32) -> (result: bool)
        requires self.valid(), bit < self.len,
        ensures result == self.live(bit as int),
set:
pub fn set(&mut self, bit: u32) -> (result: bool)
        requires old(self).valid(), bit < old(self).len,
        ensures
            final(self).valid(),
            final(self).len == old(self).len,
            final(self).data@.len() == old(self).data@.len(),
            final(self).data@ == old(self).data@.update(bit as int / 64,
                old(self).data@[bit as int / 64] | (1u64 << (bit as int % 64))),
            result == (final(self).data@[bit as int / 64] == u64::MAX),
            forall|query: int| 0 <= query < final(self).len ==>
                #[trigger] final(self).live(query) ==
                    (if query == bit as int { true } else { old(self).live(query) }),
clear:
pub fn clear(&mut self, bit: u32)
        requires old(self).valid(), bit < old(self).len,
        ensures
            final(self).valid(),
            final(self).len == old(self).len,
            final(self).data@.len() == old(self).data@.len(),
            final(self).data@ == old(self).data@.update(bit as int / 64,
                old(self).data@[bit as int / 64] & !(1u64 << (bit as int % 64))),
            forall|query: int| 0 <= query < final(self).len ==>
                #[trigger] final(self).live(query) ==
                    (if query == bit as int { false } else { old(self).live(query) }),
